name: generate_music
description: 🎵 Generate original AI music: songs, instrumentals, jingles, beats, and soundtracks. Use for 'make a song', 'create a jingle', 'generate background music', or 'compose an instrumental'. Describe musical characteristics instead of naming artists, bands, copyrighted songs or lyrics, or requesting voice imitation; those requests can be rejected. ElevenLabs supports 3-second to 10-minute tracks and structured composition plans. Gemini defaults to a 30-second clip; the optional Pro model creates full songs with prompt-controlled duration. Output saves to the audio gallery and stash for playback. Not for downloading an existing track; use stash or youtube_video for that.

prompt.description: Describe mood, instruments, genre, arrangement, and an original lyric theme. Do not name artists or bands, copy copyrighted songs or lyrics, or request voice imitation. Example: 'An upbeat summer pop song with catchy guitar riffs and original positive lyrics about adventure'.

title.description: Song title for saving and display. Defaults to first 50 chars of prompt.

duration_seconds.description: Requested length in seconds. ElevenLabs supports 3-600 seconds. Gemini Lyria Clip ignores this value and always returns 30 seconds; Lyria Pro treats it as an approximate prompt target.

genre.description: Music genre. Enhances prompt with genre-specific production hints.

mood.description: Emotional tone: happy, sad, energetic, calm, mysterious, epic, romantic, dark, hopeful, nostalgic

instrumental.description: If true, generates instrumental music with no vocals. Default false.

tempo.description: Speed: 'slow', 'medium', 'fast', or specific BPM like '120 BPM'

output_format.description: ElevenLabs accepts MP3 and Opus presets. The Gemini adapter accepts only an MP3 preset and controls the resulting MP3 encoding.

provider.description: Music provider override. Supports elevenlabs and gemini; omit to use the configured default.

composition_plan.description: Advanced ElevenLabs-only composition plan. Has 'global_styles' and 'sections'. Each section: {section_name, duration_seconds, styles[], avoid_styles[], lyrics[]}.

save.description: Save to stash for web UI playback (default: true)

availability.setup_hint: Set MUSIC_TOOL_PROVIDER and the matching ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
